top_signals.title: Dollar Slides Toward Worst Day in Two Months After US Midterms
top_signals.summary: The dollar sank the most in two months as Democrats’ sweeping victory in the midterm elections fueled concern about potential political gridlock and raised the prospect of diminished spending on AI by US tech giants.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Saildrone expands its European market reach with manufacturing partner in Norway
top_signals.summary: CEO Tom Fidjeland told reporters at the Euronaval trade show here that taking on the work of churning out Surveyors was “technically not difficult,” with a first mold already being readied.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Democrats map out an agenda to address affordability and corruption after midterm sweep
top_signals.summary: In control of Congress, Democrats are preparing to pursue legislation to address affordability, while also trying to rein-in President Donald Trump
